Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Asif Kalim, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Abhay Kumar Roy, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
4 08-01-2025
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
Nobody appears for opposite party no.2 inspite of valid service of notice on her.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during pendency of the bail petition, due to intervention of well wishers of both parties, the dispute has been resolved and parties have decided not to purse the case further.
4. Considering the aforesaid facts, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66473 of 2022(4) dt.08-01-2025 enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bettiah, West Champaran in Complaint Case No. 964C/2020, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure as well as in terms of settlement.
